title: a refused ask names the refusal, not a missing handler
intention: When a gate answers a ticket's queueme and refuses, the trouble the ticket raises says the holder refused, in the same words every time, with the holder's reason in its detail, instead of saying no handler took it.
why: Measured 2026-11-16: all 12 occurrences of the 9 live ticket-unqueued-*-at-clearance troubles were codemother's clearance gate answering accepted False with a reason, and every why said 'no handler took it'. That is a false record of truth (Law 7): the reason stayed buried in detail.reply.
traces_to: Law 7: errors are permanent in records of truth, and a record of truth never collapses an error into a coherent shape.
how: In Ticket.queueme's 'if not queued' branch, a reply with accepted False, no is_bounce, no error and a non-empty reason raises the fixed why '<holder> refused it (its reason is in the detail)', and detail.reason carries the reason (outline 3.4.3.2.1/3: a raiser's error is the same words every time, and what varies goes in the details). A bounce or timeout keeps 'no handler took it'. The identity ticket-unqueued-<id>-at-<gate> is unchanged, so 41a5bae3d01b's clear-on-take still works.

clauses.claim: a refused reply (accepted False with a reason) raises a why that says the holder refused and does not say 'no handler took it', the same words for two different reasons, with the reason in detail.reason; the ticket is not queued
a bounce and a timeout still raise a why saying 'no handler took it'
the refusal raises ticket-unqueued-<id>-at-<gate>, and a later taken ask clears it

decisions.text: D1: queueme words a holder's refusal as a fixed refusal why, the reason in detail.reason; bounce and silence keep the old wording; the identity is unchanged.
D2: a red-first proof scripts the three reply shapes into a scratch ticket, one tooth per clause, after test_a_taken_ticket_clears_its_unqueued_trouble.py.

measured.saw: 9 live ticket-unqueued-*-at-clearance troubles, 12 occurrences, every reply accepted False with a reason (e.g. 'PROVEME crossing refused: component base reds the build_inspector'); none a bounce, none a timeout
measured.how: bin/cairn trouble live --json, reading each occurrence's detail.reply

measured.saw: the new proof red 1/3 on origin/main (tooth 1: the why said 'no handler took it'), green 3/3 with the fix at 44a4d62bf; the 6 other ticket-machine proofs green
